caption:
Four numbers decide your revenue.

Leads. Close rate. Average job value. Repeat rate. Multiply them together and you get your total.

Most owners only pull one lever, spending more on leads every year while the other three sit untouched. Ad spend climbs. Profit doesn't.

The cheapest lever to pull is close rate. It costs no extra ad spend and usually comes down to one thing: how fast you respond to a new lead.

Run your own four numbers and see which lever is worth the most this week.
